cards.card_text: And in front of him, the LORD routs Sisera, all his charioteers and all his army with the sword.
cards.verse_text: And in front of him the LORD routed with the sword Sisera, all his charioteers, and all his army.

cards.card_text: David captures a thousand chariots, SEVEN thousand charioteers and TWENTY thousand foot soldiers from Hadadezer.
cards.verse_text: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.

cards.card_text: David kills seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers.
cards.verse_text: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers.
cards.snippet: But the Arameans fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers.

cards.card_text: Badly wounded, Ahab tells his charioteer to turn around and take him out of the battle.
cards.verse_text: So the king said to his charioteer, “Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am badly wounded!”

cards.card_text: Up on the tower, the watchman says the charioteer is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi.
cards.verse_text: And the charioteer is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi—he is driving like a madman!”
cards.snippet: And the charioteer is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi—he is driving like a madman!”
